lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively wide in the anterior torso (shoulder area) and becomes progressively compressed towards the posterior (rump) region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 5, 6, and 7 from the anterior exhibit significant attenuation and terminate mid-torso before reaching the ventral fringe boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the mid-thigh align to form a semi-horizontal geometric vector.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial lateral divergence from the skull base followed by a strong medial and dorsal convergence; tips oriented vertically at approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.2 times the pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A Red-billed Oxpecker is currently attached to the posterior side of the right hind limb at the metatarsal level.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial chevron between the eyes, two distinct white spots on the lower maxillary region, and a dense, dark-toned ventral hair fringe spanning from the neck to the groin.
